_source: Values transcribed from Hsin-Wei's old ZbAnalysis_boosted workflow (Configs/config.ini, xSec_18 fields, with any *k-factor already multiplied in). Used instead of BTVNanoCommissioning's shared helpers/xsection.py database because several entries there diverge substantially from these (e.g. WW 75.9 vs 118.7 pb, WZ 27.57 vs 47.13 pb, ST s-channel 3.74 vs 10.32 pb) -- using the shared database's generic values would normalize this workflow's plots inconsistently with Hsin-Wei's established results, defeating the point of an old-vs-new comparison. Keys match the dataset names in QCD_sf_run2018_all.json.
